Title: SQL Injection in Product Filter Lookup
Technical_Impact: Unauthorized access to target database layer strings via raw parameter concatenation.
Business_Impact: Simulated leakage of restricted customer catalog information profiles.
Recommendation: Implement parameterized query structures using prepared statements across the data extraction engines.
Retest_Criteria: Nessus or manual payload check confirming that true Boolean statements alter zero logic tracks.

Title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via Product Search
Technical_Impact: Client-side script execution context within target browser workspace.
Business_Impact: Simulated session token capture risks impacting target customer storefront access.
Recommendation: Enforce context-aware HTML entity output encoding rules across all dynamic template variables.
Retest_Criteria: Verify that raw markup inputs return as plain text and do not execute scripts.

Title: Missing Authorization Check on Administrative Interface
Technical_Impact: Complete unauthenticated execution tracking across sensitive platform management daemons.
Business_Impact: Simulated deletion of client accounts causing service disruption.
Recommendation: Enforce server-side deny-by-default access filters that explicitly require verified administrative tokens.
Retest_Criteria: Verify that an anonymous query returns a 401 Unauthorized or 403 Forbidden status code.

Title: Multi-Factor Authentication State Bypass
Technical_Impact: Circumvention of second-factor controls allowing direct account dashboard access.
Business_Impact: Simulated access takeover of customer payment history blocks.
Recommendation: Enforce state-locked session checks that require multi-factor verification before returning data.
Retest_Criteria: Confirm that a direct request to the account view redirects back to the 2FA prompt.
